_comment: The exhausted-retry stall notice of implement.yml pinned from main 6f04355 (post spec 040, 2026-08-24 merge). Pinned as CONTENT because CI checkouts are shallow, so a git-ref baseline is unreadable there. If main rewords these steps again, regenerate this file deliberately, in its own reviewed change.

Mark lifecycle record stalled.run:
jq '.stage = "stalled"' "$SPEC_DIR/spec-meta.json" > /tmp/meta.json
mv /tmp/meta.json "$SPEC_DIR/spec-meta.json"
git config user.name  "${BOT_SLUG}[bot]"
git config user.email "${BOT_SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add "$SPEC_DIR/spec-meta.json"
# A restarted iteration that fails again finds the record already
# stalled; committing nothing must not kill the job before the
# issue report below runs.
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "spec-meta.json already reads stage=stalled — nothing to commit." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  git commit -m "implement: mark $SLUG stalled (iteration $ITERATION failed)"
  git push
fi

Report stalled on lifecycle issue.run:
gh label create "stage:stalled" --color E99695 --description "Stage did not complete; manual restart required" --force gh issue edit "$ISSUE" --add-label "stage:stalled" gh issue edit "$ISSUE" --remove-label "stage:implement" 2>/dev/null || true gh issue edit "$ISSUE" --remove-label "stage:tasks" 2>/dev/null || true # 4-backtick fence so an agent message containing ``` blocks nests. fence='````' # NOTE: no apostrophes inside ${VAR:-default} — bash parses quotes # inside ${} even within double quotes (this exact line once broke # the whole report with "unexpected EOF"). reason_text="$REASON" [ -n "$reason_text" ] || reason_text="see the failing run's step summary" restart_workflow="$SELF_WORKFLOW" [ -n "$restart_workflow" ] || restart_workflow="" # A stall arrives in one of two states: the failed pass either recorded # its iteration before dying, or its push never landed and the record # still reads the previous one. Only the agent writes `iteration`; the # stall commit above touches `.stage` alone. Since the guard admits a # stalled stage only at recorded+1, the restart has to be derived from # the record — $ITERATION+1 is right in the first state and a dispatch # the guard drops as a duplicate in the second. An unreadable record # falls back to $ITERATION rather than killing the report. recorded=$(jq -r '.iteration // 0' "$SPEC_DIR/spec-meta.json" 2>/dev/null) || recorded="" case "$recorded" in ''|*[!0-9]*) recorded="$ITERATION" ;; esac restart_iteration=$((recorded + 1)) { echo "⏸️ **Implementation stalled** — iteration $ITERATION of the implement/converge loop failed (last attempt on \`$TIER\`), and no higher model tier remains to escalate to, so this specification is now **stalled** (nothing restarts automatically)." echo "" echo "**Failing run**: $RUN_URL" echo "**Why the attempt was judged failed**: $reason_text" if [ -n "$AGENT_MSG" ]; then echo "" echo "
Agent's final message (last attempt — usually states exactly what blocked it)" echo "" echo "$fence" printf '%s\n' "$AGENT_MSG" echo "$fence" echo "" echo "
" fi echo "" echo "### Runbook — restarting this specification" echo "" echo "1. **Diagnose** — open the [failing run]($RUN_URL): the step summary says which attempt failed and why, and its \`claude-execution-output-cycle\` / \`-retry\` artifacts hold the full agent transcripts." echo "2. **Fix the cause** — e.g. missing bot permissions, a broken task, an unreachable dependency." echo "3. **Restart** — re-dispatch the implement wrapper workflow via **Run workflow** with these inputs (GitHub cannot prefill them from a link):" echo "" echo " | input | value |" echo " |---|---|" echo " | \`spec_dir\` | \`$SPEC_DIR\` |" echo " | \`issue\` | \`$ISSUE\` |" echo " | \`iteration\` | \`$restart_iteration\` |" echo "" echo " or from a terminal:" echo "" echo " \`\`\`" echo " gh workflow run $restart_workflow -R $GITHUB_REPOSITORY -f spec_dir=$SPEC_DIR -f issue=$ISSUE -f iteration=$restart_iteration" echo " \`\`\`" } > /tmp/stall-comment.md
